title: rest.users.update.request
description: PATCH /api/users/{user_id} body: at least one of the two fields, each absent meaning keep what the user has; an email of the empty string clears it (protocol 1.8).

name.description: The student's name as they write it, trimmed: 1 to 80 characters, not blank.

email.description: The new email; the empty string clears it and absent keeps the current one.
